This is the default configuration for Tiny Tapeout projects. It should fit most designs.
If you change it, please make sure you understand what you are doing. We are not responsible
if your project fails because of a bad configuration.
!!! DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE unless you know what you are doing !!!
If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
HYDRA v3 (2026-10-09): 60 -> 70 for the move from 4x4 to 3x4.
HYDRA v3.2 (2026-10-13): 70 -> 60. 3x4 did not route (detailed routing
went 10085, 5223, 4558, 4338, 4190: not converging), so the tile is 4x4 again, where the
cells fill about 52% of the core. 60 is the template default and spreads
them, which is what routing needs.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
HYDRA session 139: raised 20 -> 55 ns (~18 MHz). The 20 ns default
failed setup at the TYPICAL corner, not just slow -- the MOM's
combinational depth (~33 ns pre-repair, session 132) does not fit a
20 ns period, and OpenSTA measured 46.56 ns reg-to-reg pre-buffer,
so even 40 ns would fail. 55 ns clears the measured path with margin
that does not depend on PAR recovery. Re-lower after the fanout work.
66 ns (2026-10-02): every corner meets setup once the reset was
synchronised -- worst slow-corner slack +2.184 ns. The same 66 ns failed
before that change, so the reset network, not logic depth, was the limit.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
Setup-side resizing (session 139): the run hit RSZ-0062 and slew/cap
violations in every corner, the classic under-buffered high-fanout
signature. Margins push the resizer to fix them before signoff.
Slew and capacitance (v3.2, 2026-10-13). Every harden so far ended with
about 5,000 max-slew warnings at the slow corner (4764, 4996, 5039) and
about 20 max-capacitance ones, and FIRST_TRY.md's go/no-go requires 0.
Design repair sizes buffers at the typical corner only (DEFAULT_CORNER),
with a 20% margin, so slews that pass there fail at ss_100C_1v60. These
margins make it aim further under the limit so the slow corner passes
too. RESULT (v3.2, 2026-10-14): 5,039 -> 3,665 only, and the repair step
took hours; v3.3 at 50% with real buffers then hung in that step for over
a day (net 7000 of 11823). Back to the default 20 (v3.4, 2026-10-17): the
real cause is the buffer cell, below, not the margin.
v3.3 (2026-10-15): the v3.2 harden (4x4, sign-off clean) still had 3665
slew and 11 capacitance warnings. tools/slew_report.py traced every one of
the worst nets, at the slow and the typical corner alike, to a fanout
buffer the resizer had built from sky130_fd_sc_hd__clkdlybuf4s25_1 -- a
clock DELAY cell, weak by design, each driving 10 to 15 loads (1093 of
them; the same cell type it used for the input buffers). A wider margin
cannot help a cell that cannot drive. Excluding the delay-buffer family
makes the resizer build fanout trees from real buffers. Hold repair keeps
dlygate4sd3, which is what it used. Confirmed in effect on 2026-10-16 (the
input buffers became buf_1); its effect on slew is UNVERIFIED until a
harden completes. tools/harden_ladder.py falls back to the proven settings
(this line removed) if it stalls or fails.
RESULT (v3.4, 2026-10-17): signed off clean, +11.142 ns, but 4197 slew
(slow corner) and 30 capacitance warnings remain.
v3.5 (2026-10-17): the delay cells are gone, and the same mechanism moved
one cell up. In the v3.4 run all 1082 fanoutNNN buffers are buf_1, and
nets they drive (3 to 13 loads) carry 88% of the violating pins at
max_ss_100C_1v60 and 92% at nom_tt_025C_1v80. Slew is near zero where
repair looks (11 after CTS, 57 after global routing, typical corner,
estimated wires) and jumps to 635 / 4197 on the extracted wires. Repair
picks the weakest buffer that passes its estimate. Excluding the
drive-strength-1 buffers (buf_1, clkbuf_1) makes every fanout buffer at
least a _2, about twice the drive. One change; the ladder falls back to
the v3.4 settings if it does not sign off.
RESULT (v3.5, 2026-10-17, rung drive2, 12 min): REJECTED. The resizer
did not move to buf_2; it took the next weakest buffer-function cell,
dlygate4sd3_1 (a delay gate), for every fanout buffer and the input
buffers. Slew fell to 3298 and capacitance to 8, but setup failed at
max_ss_100C_1v60 by -2.403 ns (the delay gates sit on the paths).
LVS, DRC, antenna 0; 53.7%. Back to the v3.4 setting below. The lesson:
repair picks the weakest buffer it is allowed, so a list must leave no
weak one -- the delay gates included.
v3.6 (2026-10-17, rung realbuf2, 14 min): exclude every weak and delay
buffer, so repair can only pick a _2 or stronger real buffer (hold repair
then uses real buffers too). SIGNED OFF CLEAN: DRC, LVS, antenna 0; setup
+14.836 ns, hold +0.106 ns; 48.9%; slew 4197 -> 775 (slow corners only:
max_ss 775, nom_ss 559, min_ss 322; typical and fast 0); capacitance
30 -> 0; 21/21 on the hardened netlist.
v3.9 (2026-10-18, rung realbuf35): the same exclusions with the slew
repair margin 20 -> 35%. Clean (DRC, LVS, antenna 0; setup +10.314 ns,
hold +0.107 ns; 49.0%; 21/21 gate level) but NOT ADOPTED: slow corners
759 / 480 / 265 against v3.6's 775 / 559 / 322, and one net (a buf_2
fanout buffer with 15 loads) now fails at the three typical corners (16
each), where v3.6 had 0. The margin stays at 20; what is left is buf_2
fanout buffers and gates driving 10-16 loads, a fanout problem.
Antenna repair. Session 139 set RUN_ANTENNA_REPAIR and GRT_REPAIR_ANTENNAS,
but checked against LibreLane 3.0.14 the second is a deprecated alias of the
first and both default to on -- that block changed nothing. The settings
that act are the repair passes and margins below. The 66 ns run with the
synchronised reset closed timing at every corner but left ONE antenna
violation (ratio 1.21 on met1) after the default 3 detailed-routing repair
passes. More passes, and a wider margin so nets close to the limit get a
diode before they cross it.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
